proposal.hypothesis: The fully inverted robot rests on a broad, nearly flat torso while every foot is 0.3–0.5 m above the floor. A light segmented dorsal keel creates a narrow unstable support line, allowing the existing bounded waist retry moment and impact momentum to roll the torso into a side-contact basin where a foot can become reachable.
proposal.expectedEffect: Increase departure from the pi-radian inverted pose and produce at least one foot-contact opportunity in the complete no-reset Mission without changing controller authority, exceeding 6.5 kg, or regressing command tracking and collision gates.
